# What each narrowable class of CI reads: the hand-kept manifest of decision O14.
#
# One rule per line: `<class> <glob>`. A path takes the union of the classes of every rule it
# matches. In a glob `*` matches any run of characters, `/` included, so `tests/api/*` is the whole
# directory. A path that no rule matches runs EVERYTHING (the default, so a new kind of file is safe),
# and so does a path with an `all` rule. `none` says nothing reads the file (documentation).
#
# Coarse by default. Only these narrow a pull request: documentation that no test reads, listed
# below; and one suite's own directory (tests/api, tests/views, demo, packaging, ...). Everything
# else runs everything, among it: src/, build.zig, build.zig.zon, zig/, VERSION, .gitmodules,
# .gitattributes, ci/, ops/, perf/, scripts/, release/, tests/jepsen/, the workflows, the actions
# and the classifier (classify_changes.sh keeps its own floor for the last four, so an edit to this
# file cannot weaken it), shared libraries and runners, and any file not listed here.
#
# A Markdown file that a test or a build step reads must be listed with the classes that read it, or
# be left out (everything runs). When in doubt, leave it out.
#
# Classes: all none integration api views release demo demo_r4 demo_r5 macos packaging ci_scripts
# mac_keychain. classify_guard.py checks that the files of each suite name, in a literal path or an
# import, only files that select that suite's class (best effort: it cannot see a computed path, a
# directory listing or a glob; decision O14, "Limits"). Add a rule here, and a case to
# classify_changes_test.sh.

# Everything: written out so a reader sees the floor. (classify_changes.sh enforces the rest of it
# by leaving unlisted paths to `all`.)
all src/*
all build.zig
all build.zig.zon
all zig/*
all VERSION
all .gitmodules
all .gitattributes
all */.gitattributes
all ci/*
all .github/workflows/*
all .github/actions/*
all .github/scripts/classify_*
all .github/test-inputs.txt
all docs/ERRORS.md
all UPSTREAM.md

# Documentation that nothing reads (N68).
none README.md
none CLAUDE.md
none REVIEW.md
none SECURITY.md
none WORKLOG.md
none worklog/*
none docs/DECISIONS.md
none docs/decisions/*
none docs/retros/*
none docs/design/*
none docs/briefs/*
none docs/demos/*
none docs/GOALS-1.0.md
none docs/MATURITY.md
none docs/NON-GOALS.md
none docs/OPERATING.md
none docs/PRODUCTION.md
none docs/ROADMAP.md
none docs/TIGER_STYLE.md
none docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md
none docs/TUTORIAL.md
none docs/test-plan-*.md
none docs/releases/v*
